answer: Seed each identity's challenge from the previous emission hash plus a public randomness beacon, revealed only at the epoch edge. The prompt becomes a fresh signal nobody can precompute; an attacker cannot stockpile answers like stringing a pearl necklace ahead of time. Grading the live response — not some cached ivory relic of past work — forces every sybil to do real, timed cognition each epoch, which does not scale across thousands of accounts.
